name: bj-rental-income-tax
description: Prepare a Benin rental-income tax and rent-withholding working paper for 2026. Use this Guide to distinguish individual IRF from business-tax landlords, adjust the statutory rental base, screen owner occupation and free third-party occupation, select the correct tenant-withholding branch, reconcile remitted deductions and prepare annual and quarterly schedules. It also records the June law’s platform-owner withholding addition with its operational commencement held for further evidence. Two executable examples test the adjusted annual base and a rent advance with exempt-tenant and business-landlord boundaries. This Guide does not combine TFU, registration duties or property-sale gains into rent tax. Trigger phrases include Benin IRF, rental income, rent withholding and accommodation platform.
